subject: SOC2 recert + renewal: retention window, term options, capacity
messages:
From: Jordan Patel <security+redwood@nimblefinance.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimblefinance.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 recert + contract renewal: retention window and add'l seats

Kimberly —

As we approach our November renewal, Security and Procurement want to align on a few requirements before we sign the next term. High level asks:

- SOC 2 recert: we need the most recent attestation letter and an ETA for completion of your upcoming recert (we were told Q4).
- Audit evidence: we’ll need a short evidence bundle (logs + process docs) covering the last 90 days; can you confirm preferred file formats and a secure upload mechanism?
- Retention: our compliance team requires a 540-day audit log retention for a scoped set of events (auth, admin, data-export). Can Redwood support this as part of the renewal or via an addendum?
- Seats/capacity: we’re evaluating a +30% committed capacity uplift for next year; please include pricing / options for Dedicated reserved capacity or committed throughput.

Can you send a compliance playbook and an artifact map so we can brief our auditor? We’d like an initial plan and timeline by Friday (10/23).

Thanks,
Jordan Patel
Security Lead — NimbleFinance
security+redwood@nimblefinance.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + contract renewal: retention window and add'l seats

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. Short response and proposed plan below; Marcus (security) will follow with the technical details.

What we can do now:
- SOC 2 attestation: our latest Type II report (2025) and the attestation letter are attached. The formal recert process kicked off last month; target completion remains end of Q4 (we’ll provide progress updates weekly).
- Evidence bundle: we can produce a 90-day evidence export. Preferred delivery is an encrypted S3 package (AES-256) or a secure transfer link (we’ve included a Drive folder stub below). We’ll provide an evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx that maps artifacts to auditor requests.
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention on audit/log exports; for the scoped event types you list we offer a managed retention tier (up to 3 years) as an add-on or as part of a 24-month committed term.
- Capacity / seats: Ben will send optional pricing for (a) hosted with committed throughput, (b) Dedicated reserved GPU pool, and (c) a blended term with burst capacity.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Quick intake call (45–60m) to confirm events and evidence slices — are you available Thu 10/22 at 10:00am PT?
2) We’ll share evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx and a draft term amendment (PDF) by EOD Wednesday.
3) Marcus to outline the log export format and minimal retention configuration for the auditor.

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub), latest_attestation_2025.pdf (attached)

Best,
Kimberly Park

Jordan / Procurement —

Thanks for the heads up. Pricing summary (high level):
- 12-month renewal (baseline): no change to retention; standard hosted pricing applies.
- 24-month committed term: includes managed retention tier up to 18 months for scoped logs + 10% discount on token rates.
- Dedicated reserved capacity (NVIDIA A100-class pools): quoted as an uplift; we can commit a 30% throughput increase at a fixed monthly commit (details in the attached draft_term_amendment_NIM-045.pdf).

If you want the 540-day (≈18 months) retention as a contractual requirement, that maps to the 24-month committed term option or a separate retention addendum. We can produce an addendum and route through DocuSign the same day you confirm. DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/NIM-045

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Patel <security+redwood@nimblefinance.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 recert + contract renewal: retention window and add'l seats

Jordan —

Follow-up from the security engineering side with the technical specifics you asked for. Short answers first, details below.

Can do:
- Export formats: gzipped JSON lines (.jsonl.gz) or compressed parquet. We can also produce CSV slices for specific event types.
- Delivery: encrypted S3 export (pre-signed, server-side encryption) or one-time SFTP push to an auditor endpoint.
- Retention: we support tiered retention on the log archive; for the three scoped event classes (auth, admin, data-export) we can set a separate retention policy that retains on our archive for 540 days and exposes index metadata for search.
- Audit trail: every evidence bundle includes a manifest with checksums and a signed export log.

Minimal config we need from your side:
- Exact event list (enumerate auth/admin/data-export event names)
- Which export format you prefer (.jsonl.gz preferred for large volumes)
- Auditor access: either an S3 endpoint we push to, or contact details for your auditor for a temporary SFTP account

Sample retention policy (for transparency):
- Hot store: 30 days (fast query)
- Warm archive: 31–540 days (searchable metadata, slower retrieval)
- Cold archive: >540 days (object storage, retrieval on request)

I’ve included a small sample bundle attachment (nimble_sample_logs.tar.gz) with anonymized events to validate format. Let me know the exact event list and we’ll schedule the export.

—Marcus
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
(Attachment: nimble_sample_logs.tar.gz)
